definition.title: Staircase Sounds: Lache Cercel & The Roma Jazz Ensemble

registrationInfo.onlineInstructions:
Thank you for registering for this event! Please note that this event takes place in an open, public space and we will not be checking tickets. We use registration to estimate audience size and send out updates if necessary. Registration does not guarantee a seat.

We will have about 130 seats available, a mixture of stools, benches, and chairs spread throughout the space. Please arrive early if you want to ensure you have a seat. There will be plenty of standing room available for folks who are comfortable standing. There will be a section of seating reserved for those with accessibility needs.

This concert takes place on the 8th floor of the Central Library. Follow the posted signs to find the performance space.
